Hi Alex —

Great to meet earlier today — thanks for the product demo and for walking through your expected usage patterns. Key MAP milestone we've highlighted here is Vendor Onboarding / Procurement (Ariba/Coupa setup, vendor forms, W-9, banking details).

- Action: Share Redwood vendor form & MAP draft (attached) — Owner: Redwood (me) — Due: 2026-10-04
- Action: Confirm Acme procurement contact + Ariba supplier code — Owner: Acme — Due: 2026-10-05
- Action: Redwood to provide completed vendor form + W-9 when requested — Owner: Redwood Finance (cc'd) — Due: 2026-10-06
- Dependency: Ariba supplier setup required before purchase order issuance
- Target close for advanced pilot procurement: 2026-10-15

I've attached the MAP draft (MAP-Acme-20261001.xlsx) and our Redwood vendor intake PDF (Redwood_VENDOR_FORM.pdf) for your procurement team. If you want, I can loop in our procurement lead to coordinate the Ariba/Coupa steps directly.

Please confirm the procurement contact and whether Acme requires a PO or invoice-first flow.

Thanks,
